Three.js r128 and the matching classic-script GLTFLoader, unmodified, used by the standalone hat studio.

Upstream: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r128

Files: `build/three.min.js` and `examples/js/loaders/GLTFLoader.js`.
